tools.name: get_me
tools.description: Get basic information about the bot itself.

tools.name: get_chat
tools.description: Get information about a chat (user, group, or channel) by its ID or @username.

tools.name: get_updates
tools.description: Fetch recent messages/events sent to the bot (long-poll style, non-destructive).

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a text message to a chat, group, or channel.

tools.name: send_video
tools.description: Send a video to a chat, group, or channel — either fetched by Telegram from a URL, or uploaded directly as base64 content.

videoUrl.description: A URL Telegram will fetch the video from

contentBase64.description: Video file content, base64-encoded (use instead of videoUrl)
